meta.strategy: canonical server V4 + post-entry failure guard

pre_registered_variants.entry_guard_cash: new holding shock exits to cash until the next fixed grid
pre_registered_variants.entry_guard_v4_or_cash: new holding shock switches on first full V4 consensus; otherwise exits to cash until the next fixed grid
pre_registered_variants.entry_guard_best_or_cash: new holding shock switches to the strongest eligible positive-trend alternative that beats the holding on both 3d and 5d return; otherwise exits to cash
pre_registered_variants.entry_guard_selective: a one-day shock switches only when a positive relative replacement exists; otherwise it holds, while a <= -10% post-entry loss exits to cash until the next fixed grid

meta.no_lookahead: guard uses entry price, holding age, and closes/factors through T only; forward returns are reporting only
